---
name: Stale or incorrect rule
about: A store rule in this project is out of date, wrong, or missing
title: "[rule] "
labels: rule-accuracy
---

**This is the most valuable issue you can file.** A stale rule is worse than no rule — it
makes someone confident about the wrong thing right before they submit.

### Which rule

Rule ID (e.g. `PLAY-TARGETSDK`) or reference document and section:

### What it currently says

### What it should say

### Authoritative source

A link to developer.apple.com, support.google.com, or developer.android.com.
**Blog posts and forum threads are not sufficient** — the project only encodes rules that
can be traced to the store's own documentation.

- URL:
- Date the source page was last updated (if shown):

### Effective date

Is this in force now, or does it start on a specific date?

### Anything else

Rejection text you received, a Play Console policy notice, a screenshot — anything that
shows the rule being enforced in practice.
